name: NFAA tournament calendar (state, sectional, national events)
terms: Not checked (site blocked from sandbox). Site runs on the same vendor platform as usarchery.org (93ft; mirror host nfaa.93ft.com), so check NFAA's own terms before scraping; NFAA is a separate org from USA Archery.
notes: Best multi-state lead for the Northeast. Search results show per-event pages (/events/event-information/<id>) with venue name + full street address + dates, plus section pages (e.g. /sections/new-england, /sections/mid-atlantic) and per-state news (/news/state/<state>). Covers NFAA state chapter championships that otherwise have no feed: MAA (MD) State Field Champs at Anne Arundel Archers, MFAA (MA), NJ Field/Hunter/Animal at Garden State Archers (Wrightstown), New England Indoor Sectionals (Thomaston CT, Rochester NH, Worcester & S. Attleboro MA, North Yarmouth ME). Calendar can be filtered by state/type on the site. Look for a JSON endpoint behind the filter UI (93ft platform) once access works; ask NFAA for permission given the USA Archery precedent.

name: NASP Tournament Explorer
organization: National Archery in the Schools Program (NASP)
notes: ASP.NET site; Tournament Explorer filters by state and timeframe; detail pages at tournamentdetail.aspx?tid=<id> (e.g. 2026 Maryland State NASP Bullseye tid=15557 and 3D tid=15558, Mar 13-14 2026). Covers all 11 states incl. state qualifiers. Youth/school-only events: consider tagging as 'youth/NASP' so they don't flood the adult list. Scraping a postback-driven ASP.NET form is fragile; check for a GET-able list URL.

name: IBO events / national triple crown and state championships
notes: Unverified: ibo.org and iboscores.com both blocked from sandbox, and search returned nothing useful about their event lists. Known: 2026 IBO National Triple Crown leg at Hocking College, Nelsonville OH (Jul 9-12); IBO events historically at Franklin, PA. Northeast is IBO heartland (PA/NY state championships, Eastern/Northeast qualifiers) so it's worth re-checking from a networked machine. If ibo.org is WordPress, try /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events.

name: IBO Scores event list
notes: Unverified: blocked, and no search results described its structure. Re-check: it's likely a scoring app focused on results rather than an upcoming-events calendar.

name: Lancaster Archery Classic
notes: One big annual pro/am indoor event (PA). 2027 edition: changes announced Sep 14 2026 press release, registration opened Sep 21 2026, venue Spooky Nook Sports, 75 Champ Blvd, Manheim PA 17545. Exact 2027 dates not confirmed by search (usually late January; 2025 was Jan 23-26). One event per year, so a single manual/config entry beats building a scraper. The site is Shopify, so no feed expected.

name: ArcheryCalendar.com
terms: FLAG: competitor aggregator. Don't scrape or republish; record only. Site blocked from sandbox, terms not checked.
notes: Recorded per instructions; not a source to build on. At most, use it by hand to discover original organizer sites.

name: Boise Gun Club events directory (per-state archery/shooting events)
terms: FLAG: third-party aggregator ('listings are based on publicly available data'). Don't scrape or republish it; treat it like ArcheryCalendar.
notes: Shows up in nearly every Northeast 3D search: URLs /<state>/events/<slug>-<yyyymmdd>, with city filter (?city=). Seems auto-harvested from club calendars (it even lists 'work party', 'member meeting', 'game dinner' entries), so it's noisy. Its value is as a discovery tool: each listing names the origin club (Highland Rod & Gun RI, Anne Arundel Archers MD, Monument Beach Sportsman's Club MA, Granite State Bowhunters NH, Harrisburg Archery Club PA), whose own Google Calendars are likely the real feeds to find.

name: PSAA (Pennsylvania State Archery Association) tournaments
notes: Mechanicsburg-based state association (NFAA + USA Archery affiliate). Runs 4 state championships (Indoor, Target, Field, Bowhunter). Known 2026 events: PA State Indoor Jan 10-11 (Lancaster Archery Academy), Outdoor Aug 2 (Middletown Archery, Media), 3D Aug 8 (Keystone Rod & Gun, Bath). Search could only find these via usarchery.org, which is off-limits, so whether psaa.net has its own calendar/feed is unknown. Small volume (~4-6 events/yr). Check psaa.net for an embedded Google Calendar.

name: Western PA / Ohio 3D shoot schedule (personal site)
organization: Individual archer's page hosted on sites.pitt.edu (~mam375)
terms: Personal page on a University of Pittsburgh host; no terms seen. Ask the maintainer before scraping; it could disappear at any time.
notes: Search snippets: a comprehensive list of 3D shoots in western PA and nearby, with date, club, city, notes. Also has clubs.html (club details, fees, times) and leagues.html. Static hand-maintained HTML table: easy to parse but brittle, and depends on one person. Highest event density found for PA club shoots.

name: PA DCNR Calendar of Events (state parks/forests)
organization: Pennsylvania Dept. of Conservation and Natural Resources
notes: URL pattern (/event/<slug>) matches the Localist platform, which normally provides a public JSON API (/api/2/events) and ICS feeds. feedUrl is a GUESS from the platform pattern and is unverified. Includes real tournaments in state parks: The Denton 3D Classic (Aug 6-9 2026, Denton Hill SP) and the Eastern Traditional Archery Rendezvous (ETAR). Most archery entries, though, are intro classes ('Archery 101', 'Discover Archery'), so filter to shoots/tournaments. Low volume but official and machine-readable if the API exists.

name: PA 3D Archery directory
notes: Search snippet (via a boisegunclub listing): 'comprehensive directory and event guide for 3D archery across the state', 80+ clubs, with schedules and registration windows. Phone (814) 341-7507, 500 Duman Rd, Belsano PA. Could not find its own URL before the search budget ran out. Worth finding, since it may be the best PA 3D source.

name: Regional tourism event calendars (Potter-Tioga, Discover NEPA)
notes: Both sites show WordPress 'The Events Calendar' signatures ('Loading Events' title; discovernepa.com/event/3d-archery-shoot-2026/2026-09-27/ recurrence URL), so tribe JSON is likely. The feedUrls are guesses. Very low archery volume (handful of 3D shoots/yr); a secondary source only.

name: NYSAA (New York State Archery Association)
notes: State USA Archery association (also runs NY's NFAA-style events). 2026 indoor champs at West Falls (Feb 21-22), Proline Ozone Park (Feb 28-Mar 1), Queens/Flushing (Mar 7-8), with Neil's Archery in Endicott also a past venue. Those details were only found on usarchery.org (off-limits), so whether nysarchery.org has its own calendar is unknown. Low volume.

name: Penn-York 3D Archery league schedule
notes: Year-round 3D league + 'Barrett's Challenge' events on a published schedule page (per search snippet). Couldn't find the club URL. One club only, so low priority. NY otherwise lacks any statewide 3D/field calendar: no NYSFAA site, NY ASA Federation (past host Bear Lake Rod & Gun) or NY Bowhunters schedule turned up.

notes: URL inferred from search mention; never loaded. 2026 NJ Field/Hunter/Animal State Champs hosted by Garden State Archers, 110 Larrison Rd, Wrightstown NJ (listed on NFAA/93ft platform). NFAA calendar (multi entry) is probably the more reliable path to NJ field events.

name: New Jersey Archery Association

name: Maryland Archery Association (NFAA chapter) via NFAA calendar + club sites
organization: Maryland Archery Association; Heart of Maryland Bowhunters; Anne Arundel Archers
notes: MAA State Field Champs (28 Field + 28 Hunter) at Anne Arundel Archers, Gambrills, are listed on nfaausa.com. Couldn't locate an MAA site of its own. Heart of Maryland Bowhunters (Marriottsville) runs monthly public 3D shoots, first Sunday of the month; it uses Zeffy for tickets, which may expose an event list. Anne Arundel Archers 3D shoots (Jun 27, Jul 25 2026) look calendar-driven (seen via aggregator), so a club Google Calendar is likely. Also: MD NASP state tournaments (nasptournaments tid 15557/15558), MD 4-H State Match (Sep 26 2026, PDF only), SMA World Field Shoot (Aug 8 2026, Upper Marlboro). No statewide feed confirmed.

name: NFAA New England section / NFAA-CT via NFAA calendar; NW CT Rod & Gun (ClubExpress)
organization: NFAA Connecticut / New England Section; Northwest CT Rod & Gun Club

Possible small feed (field range Colebrook CT) but mostly work parties.

name: GOAL Affiliated Club Events calendar
organization: Gun Owners' Action League of Massachusetts (GOAL)
notes: Statewide calendar of events at affiliated sportsmen's clubs, which host many MA 3D shoots (e.g. Monument Beach Sportsman's Club, Bourne, 3D shoots Sep 20 & Oct 18 2026; Franklin County Sportsmen's Club, Deerfield). Mixed with firearms events, so it needs an 'archery/3D' keyword filter. Platform unknown; check for ICS export. MFAA (NFAA chapter) state events (indoor at Quest Archery Worcester; field at Quest Lunenburg) are best taken from the NFAA calendar. 2026 MA State/JOAD Outdoor (Hopkinton) is on usarchery.org (off-limits).

name: Vermont Bowhunters Association (3D shoots)
notes: No reliable source found. VBA sanctions regional 3D shoots (e.g. Southwest VT 3D Shoot hosted by Catamount Bow Hunters, Bennington), mostly announced in newspapers and on Facebook. Site never loaded, so whether it has an events page is unknown. Also a 3D shoot in Jericho VT (Jun 28 2026) seen in passing. No Vermont state archery association or NFAA chapter site found.

name: Granite State Bowhunters 3D shoots
notes: No reliable feed found. GSB runs ~2 shoots/yr (2026: Jun 7 and Aug 30, Androscoggin Valley Fish & Game, Berlin NH). Too few events to justify a scraper. Other NH: UNH Extension 4-H event pages (extension.unh.edu/event/..., e.g. 4-H 3D shoot at Chester Rod & Gun, May 2026); NH State/JOAD Outdoor (Aug 16 2026, Pioneer Sportsmen, Dunbarton) only on usarchery.org (off-limits); Coyote Creek Archery (Rochester) hosts NFAA sectionals via the NFAA calendar.

name: Maine Archery Association (NFAA) / Maine Bowhunters Association
organization: Maine Archery Association (Bangor); Maine Bowhunters Association
notes: No reliable feed found. Maine Archery Association (NFAA member, Bangor area) runs indoor state champs, field shoots, 3D champs and a Shooter of the Year program, but its own site URL wasn't found (seen only via aggregator). Maine Bowhunters Association runs a few events (e.g. 'Archery at Camp', Jul 25 2026, Bangor) and mostly posts on Facebook.
